items.title: Anthropic 任命首位首席全球事務官，強化 AI 政策佈局
items.title_en: Anthropic Appoints First Chief Global Affairs Officer to Strengthen AI Policy Presence
items.summary: Anthropic 宣布前加州最高法院法官 Tino Cuéllar 出任首位首席全球事務官，負責全球政策及政府關係，正值美國 AI 監管走向複雜之際。
items.summary_en: Anthropic named former California Supreme Court Justice Tino Cuéllar as its inaugural Chief Global Affairs Officer to oversee global policy and government relations amid complex US AI regulation.
items.why: AI 政策走向影響廣告 AI 工具合規，需持續追蹤監管動態。
items.why_en: AI policy shifts affect ad-tech compliance — track regulatory developments closely.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Anthropic 正式停用 Claude Opus 4.1 API，今日起所有呼叫失效
items.title_en: Anthropic Retires Claude Opus 4.1 API — All Calls Fail Immediately from Aug 5
items.summary: Anthropic 於8月5日正式停用 Claude Opus 4.1，所有 API 呼叫即時失效；建議替代版本為 claude-opus-4-8，開發者早於6月已收到60日預告。
items.summary_en: Anthropic retired claude-opus-4-1-20250805 on August 5; all API calls now fail immediately. Recommended replacement is claude-opus-4-8. Developers received 60 days' notice since June 5.
items.why: 行銷自動化工具若呼叫舊版 API，今日起即失效，需即時確認供應商已遷移。
items.why_en: Marketing automation tools calling the old API fail immediately — confirm vendor migration status now.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Claude Opus 4.7+ 正式棄用 temperature 取樣參數，API 調用須更新
items.title_en: Claude Opus 4.7+ Drops temperature/top_p/top_k Parameters — API Calls Must Update
items.summary: Anthropic 確認 Claude Opus 4.7 及更新版本中設定 temperature、top_p 或 top_k 為非預設值會回傳 400 錯誤，依賴此類參數的廣告科技平台須即時修改代碼。
items.summary_en: Anthropic confirmed that setting temperature, top_p or top_k to non-default values on Claude Opus 4.7+ now returns a 400 error. Ad-tech platforms using these parameters must update code immediately.
items.why: 依賴 Claude API 的廣告自動化工具若未更新，即時中斷，需優先排查。
items.why_en: Ad automation tools relying on these Claude parameters will break immediately — prioritise a code audit.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI 宣布 o3 推理模型8月26日從 ChatGPT 下架
items.title_en: OpenAI to Remove o3 Reasoning Model from ChatGPT on August 26
items.summary: OpenAI 確認 ChatGPT 內的 o3 推理模型（即用於複雜思考任務的進階功能）8月26日起停用，API 仍可繼續存取，官方建議用家轉用 GPT-5.6 Sol。
items.summary_en: OpenAI confirmed the o3 reasoning model will be removed from ChatGPT on August 26. API access remains; the recommended replacement is GPT-5.6 Sol for complex reasoning tasks.
items.why: 用 ChatGPT o3 做深度分析的行銷團隊需在截止日前評估切換至 GPT-5.6 Sol。
items.why_en: Marketing teams using ChatGPT o3 for complex analysis should evaluate migrating to GPT-5.6 Sol before August 26.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Luna API 定價削八成，AI 成本競爭進入新階段
items.title_en: OpenAI Cuts GPT-5.6 Luna API Price 80% — AI Cost Competition Escalates
items.summary: OpenAI 大削 GPT-5.6 Luna 定價八成（降至每百萬 token 輸入 $0.20），Sol 版本同步提速2.5倍，全行業 AI 使用成本門檻再降。
items.summary_en: OpenAI slashed GPT-5.6 Luna API pricing by 80% to $0.20/1M input tokens and sped up Sol by 2.5x — pushing AI usage costs to a new industry low.
items.why: AI API 成本急跌，代理可以更低預算擴大 AI 工具整合規模，立即評估整合方案。
items.why_en: AI API costs at historic lows — agencies can now scale AI integrations at far lower budgets. Reassess immediately.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Google Imagen 4 API 三款模型8月17日全面關閉，須遷移至 Gemini 圖像模型
items.title_en: Google Shutting Down Three Imagen 4 API Models on August 17 — Migrate to Gemini Image Models
items.summary: Google 旗下三款 Imagen 4 API 模型（含 Ultra 版）8月17日關閉，替代方案為 gemini-3.1-flash-image，廣告素材自動生成平台需盡快完成遷移。
items.summary_en: Google will shut down three Imagen 4 API models including Ultra on August 17. The recommended replacement is gemini-3.1-flash-image. Ad creative generation platforms must migrate urgently.
items.why: 用 Imagen 4 生成廣告素材的工具8月17日後即中斷，今日起需排查並遷移。
items.why_en: Ad creative tools using Imagen 4 will break on August 17 — start migration audit today.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 上線：Agent 表現超越 V4 Pro，每百萬 token 僅 $0.14
items.title_en: DeepSeek V4 Flash Officially Released: Agent Benchmarks Beat V4 Pro at $0.14/1M Tokens
items.summary: DeepSeek 正式推出 V4 Flash，3040億參數開源 Agent 模型（即 AI 代理任務引擎）在基準測試中超越 V4 Pro，MIT 授權可商用，定價每百萬 token 僅 $0.14。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek officially launched V4 Flash — a 304B-parameter open-source agent model surpassing V4 Pro on benchmarks, MIT-licensed for commercial use, at just $0.14/1M input tokens.
items.why: 極低成本的高性能 Agent 模型可用，廣告自動化工作流有更具成本效益的替代選項。
items.why_en: Ultra-low-cost, high-performance agentic AI is now production-ready — a cost-efficient alternative for ad automation workflows.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: TechCrunch：開源 AI 能力追近前沿，安全差距持續擴大引發監管關注
items.title_en: Open-Weight AI Models Near Frontier Capability as Safety Gap Widens — Regulation Pressure Builds
items.summary: 中國 Z.ai 開源模型 GLM-5.2 能力已近前沿，惟高風險任務拒絕率為零，與 Claude Opus 4.7 差距顯著，AI 安全監管爭議升溫引發業界廣泛討論。
items.summary_en: Z.ai's open-weight GLM-5.2 nears frontier AI capability but refused zero offensive cyber or bio-risk tasks tested — a stark contrast to Claude Opus 4.7 — raising major governance concerns.
items.why: AI 安全監管趨嚴可能推高廣告科技工具的合規成本，需提前關注採購策略。
items.why_en: Tightening AI safety regulation may raise ad-tech compliance costs — assess procurement strategy proactively.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

items.title: Meta Business Agent 訊息服務8月起按 token 收費，WhatsApp AI 客服成本結構改變
items.title_en: Meta Business Agent Messaging Goes Pay-Per-Token from August — WhatsApp AI CX Cost Model Changes
items.summary: Meta Business Agent（即品牌在 WhatsApp、Messenger 的 AI 客服工具）自8月1日起按 token 計費，並預告10月起服務訊息亦收費，對話行銷預算規劃需更新。
items.summary_en: Meta's Business Agent for WhatsApp and Messenger moved to per-token pricing from August 1, with further pricing changes for service messages planned for October — conversational marketing budgets need revision.
items.why: WhatsApp AI 客服由免費轉為按量付費，需重新評估對話行銷 ROI 及預算規模。
items.why_en: WhatsApp AI customer service shifts from free to pay-per-use — reassess conversational marketing ROI and budget scale.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Google Ads 8月17日 Smart Bidding 重大變更：目標出價執行更嚴格
items.title_en: Google Ads Smart Bidding Change on August 17: Target CPA/ROAS Enforcement Tightens
items.summary: Google Ads 8月17日起，預算受限廣告系列在 Target CPA/ROAS 策略下的出價執行更嚴格，不再自動壓低成本，涉及 Search、PMax 及 Shopping 等主要版位。
items.summary_en: From August 17, Google Ads will enforce Target CPA/ROAS bids more strictly for budget-limited campaigns, ending automatic under-target delivery. Affects Search, PMax, Shopping, and Demand Gen.
items.why: 若8月17日前未調整出價目標，CPA 可能悄然上升，需即時審查所有廣告系列。
items.why_en: Without updating bid targets before August 17, CPA may silently rise — audit all budget-limited campaigns immediately.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: TikTok Q3廣告新品：Symphony Agent 提示詞轉廣告、Agentic Hub AI 管理活動
items.title_en: TikTok Q3 Ad Products: Symphony Agent Turns Prompts into Ads, Agentic Hub Automates Campaign Management
items.summary: TikTok 官方 Q3 廣告產品預覽，Symphony Agent（提示詞一鍵生成廣告素材）及 Agentic Hub（AI 自動管理廣告活動）正式開放，Smart+ 搜尋廣告自動化亦同步推進。
items.summary_en: TikTok's official Q3 ad product preview introduces Symphony Agent for prompt-to-ad creative generation and Agentic Hub for AI-driven campaign management, alongside Smart+ Search Ads automation.
items.why: TikTok 廣告 AI 化加速，代理需盡早測試 Symphony Agent 以提升素材生產效率。
items.why_en: TikTok ad AI is accelerating — agencies should test Symphony Agent early to streamline creative production.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Jellyfish 推跨平台 AI 廣告優化工具，整合 PMax、ChatGPT 廣告、TikTok Search
items.title_en: Jellyfish Launches Cross-Platform AI Ads Optimization Spanning PMax, ChatGPT Ads and TikTok Search
items.summary: Jellyfish 推出跨平台 AI 廣告優化服務，以「Share of Model（AI 平台品牌佔有率）」分析整合 PMax、ChatGPT 廣告及 TikTok Search，實測 ROAS 提升逾30%。
items.summary_en: Jellyfish launched 'AI Ads Optimization', using 'Share of Model' AI insights to optimise across Google PMax, ChatGPT ads, TikTok Search and DV360 — claiming 30%+ ROAS improvement in client trials.
items.why: 跨平台 AI 廣告優化工具日趨成熟，代理商可評估類似方法論提升客戶廣告表現。
items.why_en: Cross-platform AI ad optimisation is maturing — agencies should evaluate similar methodologies to improve client performance.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: Digiday：Google 廣告反壟斷補救方案臨近，programmatic 市場格局現重大變數
items.title_en: Digiday: Google Antitrust Remedy Ruling Approaches — Programmatic Market Structure Faces Major Shift
items.summary: Digiday 分析指 Google 廣告反壟斷補救方案即將落地，加上 Teads 對 Google 廣告系統提訴，programmatic（程序廣告）市場格局現重大不確定性。
items.summary_en: Digiday's Ad Tech Briefing notes Google's antitrust remedy ruling is imminent, alongside Teads suing Google's ad tech suite — creating major uncertainty for the programmatic advertising ecosystem.
items.why: 裁決結果將影響整個程序廣告生態，代理需追蹤以提前調整 DSP/SSP 策略部署。
items.why_en: Ruling outcome could reshape programmatic advertising — agencies should track developments to adjust DSP/SSP strategy proactively.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: LinkedIn 推 AI Slop 舉報功能，B2B 行銷 AI 生成帖文觸及面臨新過濾
items.title_en: LinkedIn Launches AI Slop Reporting Button — B2B AI-Generated Content Faces New Suppression Filter
items.summary: LinkedIn 推出「AI Slop（AI 劣質水貨）」舉報按鈕及內容分類器，壓低泛化 AI 帖文曝光，配合 EU AI Act（歐盟 AI 法案）第50條8月2日正式生效。
items.summary_en: LinkedIn launched an 'AI slop' reporting button and content classifier to suppress generic AI posts, coinciding with EU AI Act Article 50 (AI content disclosure requirements) taking effect on August 2.
items.why: B2B 廣告商的 LinkedIn 內容需更多真實觀點，避免 AI 生成文章因新過濾而減少觸及。
items.why_en: B2B marketers must inject authentic perspectives into LinkedIn content — generic AI posts risk suppression under the new classifier.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技

items.title: TikTok Symphony 整合 Dreamina Seedance 2.5：廣告影片延至30秒、50個多模態參考
items.title_en: TikTok Symphony Now Integrates Dreamina Seedance 2.5 — 30-Second Ads and 50 Multimodal References
items.summary: TikTok 廣告平台官方宣布 Symphony Creative Studio 整合 Seedance 2.5，廣告影片生成由15秒延長至30秒，參考素材上限由9個升至50個，品牌視覺一致性顯著提升。
items.summary_en: TikTok officially announced that Symphony Creative Studio now integrates Seedance 2.5, extending ad video generation from 15 to 30 seconds and raising the reference input cap from 9 to 50 for improved brand consistency.
items.why: 可用更長影片敘事廣告，大幅降低廣告創意成本，今日即可在 Symphony 平台測試。
items.why_en: Longer ad video storytelling with greater brand consistency is now available in Symphony — test it today to cut creative production costs.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: 可靈 AI API 更新：3款新影片特效上線，更多模型開放接入
items.title_en: Kling AI API Updated: 3 New Video Effects Added, More Models Gain API Access
items.summary: 可靈 AI（Kling，字節旗下 AI 影片生成工具）8月3日 API 更新，新增3款影片特效，同時擴展更多視頻模型的接入支援，配合 Kling 3.0 平台持續迭代。
items.summary_en: Kling AI updated its API on August 3, adding 3 new video effects and expanding API support to more video models — continuing iteration on the Kling 3.0 platform.
items.why: 3款新影片特效直接可測試用於廣告素材，第三方工具整合可靈功能的速度同步加快。
items.why_en: Three new video effects are immediately testable for ad creatives, and expanded API access speeds up third-party tool integration.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Dreamina Seedance 2.5 全球上線：原生4K影片、50個多模態參考、局部重繪
items.title_en: Dreamina Seedance 2.5 Launches Globally: Native 4K, 50 Multimodal References, Local Re-draw
items.summary: 字節跳動旗下 Dreamina 正式推出 Seedance 2.5，支援原生4K、30秒片段、50個多模態參考素材，以及局部重繪及 R2V（即參考影片轉生成）品牌一致性功能。
items.summary_en: ByteDance's Dreamina launched Seedance 2.5 globally with native 4K, 30-second clips, 50 multimodal references, local re-draw editing, and R2V (reference video to generation) brand consistency.
items.why: 品牌廣告影片可以更長篇幅敘事同時保持一致性，節省後期修改時間及棚拍成本。
items.why_en: Brand ad videos can now tell longer stories with consistent character/product visuals — cutting post-production and reshooting costs.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Runway Aleph 2.0 + Edit Studio：修改單幀即同步全片燈光與場景
items.title_en: Runway Aleph 2.0 and Edit Studio: Edit One Frame and Changes Propagate Through the Entire Video
items.summary: Runway 推出 Aleph 2.0 及 Edit Studio，用戶只需修改影片其中一幀，模型即自動將燈光、背景及物件替換等改動套用至整段影片，面向所有付費用戶開放。
items.summary_en: Runway launched Aleph 2.0 and Edit Studio — edit a single video frame and lighting, background or object changes automatically propagate through the entire clip for all paid subscribers.
items.why: 廣告影片改版成本大降，可快速 A/B 測試不同場景與背景，素材迭代效率明顯提升。
items.why_en: Ad video revision costs drop dramatically — run A/B tests across scenes and backgrounds without full reshoots, accelerating creative iteration.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Canva AI 2.0 全面推出：對話式設計生成、Memory 品牌記憶功能現已普及
items.title_en: Canva AI 2.0 Broadly Available: Conversational Design and Memory Brand Personalisation Live
items.summary: Canva AI 2.0 現已向所有用戶推出，可用自然語言生成含品牌字體及配色的完整設計，Memory 功能自動記憶品牌偏好，令非設計師的廣告素材製作更直觀高效。
items.summary_en: Canva AI 2.0 is now available to all users — generate complete designs with brand fonts and colours through natural language, with Memory automatically retaining brand preferences for future sessions.
items.why: 廣告代理日常創作效率大升，非設計人員可快速生成品牌素材，縮短設計審批流程。
items.why_en: Agency daily creative productivity jumps — non-designers can generate on-brand assets independently, cutting design review cycles.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: CapCut Design 2.0：AI 試穿、鉛筆標記指令、智能圖層分割全面上線
items.title_en: CapCut Design 2.0: AI Clothing Try-On, Pencil Prompting and Smart Layer Split Now Live
items.summary: CapCut 推出 Design 2.0，用戶可手畫標記引導 AI 修改圖片（鉛筆提示），智能圖層分割一鍵分離主體與背景，AI 試穿功能讓零售廣告素材毋須棚拍。
items.summary_en: CapCut's Design 2.0 introduces pencil prompting for intuitive AI image edits, smart layer split for one-tap subject/background separation, and an AI clothing try-on tool for fashion and e-commerce ad creatives.
items.why: 零售客戶可快速生成 AI 試穿素材，設計修改更直觀，適合電商廣告素材批量製作。
items.why_en: Retail clients can generate try-on visuals without shoots; more intuitive AI edits cut creative turnaround for e-commerce campaigns.
items.section: 創意生產工具

items.title: Japan Airlines 率先在 ChatGPT 投廣告，以「AI 品牌佔有率」衡量 AI 搜尋成效
items.title_en: Japan Airlines Becomes First Airline to Advertise on ChatGPT, Measuring AI Search Share of Model
items.summary: Ad Age 報道 Japan Airlines 聯同代理 Jellyfish，成為首批在 ChatGPT 投放廣告的航空品牌，以「Share of Model（AI 平台品牌佔有率）」工具量度及優化品牌在 AI 搜尋的形象。
items.summary_en: Ad Age reports Japan Airlines partnered with Jellyfish to launch ChatGPT ad campaigns, using 'Share of Model' tools to track and optimise brand visibility across AI search platforms including ChatGPT and Gemini.
items.why: ChatGPT 廣告已商業化，旅遊及品牌廣告主需開始規劃 AI 搜尋平台的投放策略。
items.why_en: ChatGPT advertising is now commercially available and measurable — travel and brand advertisers should start building AI search ad strategies.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: OpenAI KOL 豪華邀請行程引強烈反彈，AI 品牌 KOL 行銷面臨倫理審視
items.title_en: OpenAI's Luxury Influencer Retreat 'Summer Club' Sparks Backlash — AI Brand KOL Marketing Under Scrutiny
items.summary: OpenAI 首個 KOL 品牌活動「Summer Club」因豪華莊園與 AI 倫理爭議形成強烈反差，引發廣泛批評，部分 KOC 被迫刪帖，為 AI 公司 KOL 行銷敲響警號。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's first 'Summer Club' influencer retreat at a luxury New York resort triggered widespread backlash over the contrast with its AI ethics positioning. Some influencers deleted posts — a cautionary tale for AI brand KOL marketing.
items.why: AI 品牌做 KOL 行銷需格外注意倫理形象配對，否則反效果可以極大。
items.why_en: AI brand influencer marketing requires careful ethics alignment — audiences intensely scrutinise AI companies' brand values.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Sony PlayStation 籌建全球廣告銷售團隊，遊戲平台廣告市場加速擴張
items.title_en: Sony Builds Global PlayStation Advertising Sales Team — Gaming Platform Ad Market Accelerates
items.summary: Sony 正籌建 PlayStation 廣告全球銷售團隊，意圖透過遊戲平台龐大用戶基礎開拓品牌廣告市場，與 Netflix、Amazon 等非傳統平台競爭品牌預算。
items.summary_en: Sony is building a global PlayStation advertising sales team to monetise its gaming platform's massive user base, competing with Netflix and Amazon for brand ad budgets.
items.why: 遊戲平台廣告庫存擴大，品牌接觸年輕高黏性受眾有新選項，可考慮納入媒體組合。
items.why_en: Growing gaming ad inventory offers brands new high-engagement channels to reach younger audiences — worth adding to media mix consideration.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Adweek 2026 Tech Stack Awards：Farfetch AI 圖像訂單增70%、AI ROI 案例充足
items.title_en: Adweek 2026 Tech Stack Awards: Farfetch AI Imagery +70% Orders — AI Marketing ROI Benchmarks Confirmed
items.summary: Adweek 2026 Tech Stack Awards 揭示 AI 行銷成效：Farfetch 運用 AI 圖像令訂單增長70%，Asics 在7分鐘內以 AI 處理逾7000張產品圖，AI 工具的商業 ROI 有具體數據佐證。
items.summary_en: Adweek's 2026 Tech Stack Awards reveal concrete AI marketing ROI: Farfetch saw 70% order growth using AI imagery; Asics processed 7,000+ product images in 7 minutes — giving agencies solid benchmarks to cite.
items.why: AI 工具 ROI 數據充足，可直接引用於客戶 pitch，增強說服力。
items.why_en: Concrete AI ROI benchmarks are now available — directly citable in client pitches to build confidence.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例

items.title: Digiday 研究：AI 購物助手成2026節慶行銷核心，消費者發現路徑正在改變
items.title_en: Digiday Research: AI Shopping Assistants Are Now Central to 2026 Holiday Marketing as Discovery Paths Shift
items.summary: Digiday+ 研究指 AI 購物助手已成節慶消費發現渠道，Mastercard 及 Ritual 等品牌確認旺季中 AI 助手是重要新觸點，廣告主在節慶廣告部署中必須相應調整。
items.summary_en: Digiday+ Research shows AI shopping assistants have become central to holiday marketing, with Mastercard and Ritual confirming they are now significant discovery touchpoints during peak season — holiday ad strategies must adapt.
items.why: 節慶廣告預算需納入 AI 搜尋助手渠道，提前規劃否則會錯失新興觸點。
items.why_en: Holiday campaign budgets must now account for AI search assistant channels — plan ahead or miss an emerging discovery touchpoint.

items.title: Zapier CMO 晉升 Chief AI Transformation Officer，行銷部門主導企業 AI 轉型
items.title_en: Zapier CMO Elevated to Chief AI Transformation Officer — Marketing Leads Company-Wide AI Adoption
items.summary: Ad Age 報道 Zapier 將 CMO Dan Slagen 升任 Chief AI Transformation Officer，以行銷部門主導企業 AI 落地，行銷最前線的 AI 應用成為企業轉型藍本。
items.summary_en: Ad Age reports Zapier elevated its CMO to Chief AI Transformation Officer, positioning the marketing team to lead company-wide AI adoption — a model other organisations facing AI pressure may follow.
items.why: CMO 角色擴張，AI 行銷能力成企業競爭力關鍵，廣告代理需強化 AI 轉型顧問角色。
items.why_en: CMO role is expanding — AI marketing fluency is becoming a company-wide competitive benchmark, raising the stakes for agency AI advisory.

items.title: 即夢 AI × 抖音 × 艾菲奖：AI 廣告爆改大賽進行中，截止8月28日
items.title_en: Jimeng AI × Douyin × Effie Awards: AI Ad Remake Contest Live Until August 28
items.summary: 即夢 AI 聯合抖音商城及艾菲奖舉辦 AI 廣告爆改大賽，邀請創作者以 AI 重演王老吉、旺旺等10+經典品牌廣告，頭獎獎勵2萬元現金加艾菲奖認證，截止8月28日。
items.summary_en: Jimeng AI, Douyin Mall, and Effie Awards are co-hosting an AI Ad Remake Contest — creators use AI to reimagine 10+ classic Chinese brand ads, with RMB 20,000 cash and Effie Awards certificates as prizes, deadline August 28.
items.why: 活動提供中國市場 AI 廣告製作實戰練習機會，有助熟悉即夢及 Seedance 工作流。
items.why_en: Live competition offering hands-on Jimeng AI practice for China market ad production — useful for learning the Seedance creative workflow.

items.title: 【實戰工作流】即夢+Seedance 2.5+CapCut 三步法：1小時完成本地化廣告素材
items.title_en: Practical Workflow: Jimeng + Seedance 2.5 + CapCut Three-Step Method — China Ad Creative in 1 Hour
items.summary: 三步工作流：①用即夢生成基礎影片→②Seedance 2.5 局部重繪補品牌細節→③CapCut 剪輯加字幕配樂，最快1小時完成一條本地化廣告素材，適合中國市場 KV 改版及 Social 廣告。
items.summary_en: A proven 3-step workflow: ① Jimeng AI generates base video → ② Seedance 2.5 local re-draw refines brand details → ③ CapCut edits captions and music. Complete a localised China market ad creative in under one hour.
items.why: 可即刻套入日常廣告素材製作，尤其適合中國市場 Social 廣告快速 A/B 測試。
items.why_en: Directly applicable to daily ad production — especially suited for rapid A/B testing of China market social ad creatives.

items.title: 36氪：2026上半年 AI 行銷全鏈路盤點 — Mizuno ROI 升125%、OPPO 搜尋滲透升30%
items.title_en: 36Kr: H1 2026 AI Marketing Full-Funnel Review — Mizuno +125% ROI, OPPO +30% Search Penetration
items.summary: 36氪整理2026上半年 AI 行銷成效：Mizuno ROI 升125%、OPPO 搜尋滲透升30%，AI 已從單點工具進化為覆蓋洞察、創作、投放及復盤的全鏈路系統。
items.summary_en: 36Kr reviews H1 2026 AI marketing performance across the full funnel: Mizuno +125% ROI, OPPO +30% search penetration — confirming AI has evolved from point tools to systematic full-funnel deployment.
items.why: 中國市場 AI 行銷 ROI 數據充足，pitch 客戶提案可直接引用具體數字提升說服力。
items.why_en: Concrete China market AI marketing ROI benchmarks are available — cite them directly in client pitch materials to build credibility.

items.title: 【即學操作】Google Ads 8月17日前必做：4步保護 Target CPA/ROAS 廣告系列
items.title_en: Action Required: 4 Steps to Protect Your Google Ads Target CPA/ROAS Campaigns Before August 17
items.summary: 應對 Google Ads 8月17日 Smart Bidding 變更：①核查預算上限設定→②確認 Target CPA 目標是否過於保守→③調整偏低出價目標→④8月17日後追蹤首周成本變化，防止 CPA 悄然上升。
items.summary_en: Four steps to protect campaigns from the August 17 Google Ads Smart Bidding change: ① audit budget caps → ② check if Target CPA targets are overly conservative → ③ adjust low bid targets → ④ monitor CPA closely the first week post-change.
items.why: 提前4步操作可避免廣告效益無聲下滑，保護節慶旺季前的廣告表現。
items.why_en: Taking these four steps now prevents silent CPA increases — protecting campaign performance ahead of the holiday peak season.
